summary.text: Star Form Child is the land spirit of Star Form blessed land, a jade-like boy formed from Star Lord Wan Xiang's lingering obsession.

claims.text: When Star Form blessed land first opened, he appeared before Fang Yuan and Hei Lou Lan in pinkish blue clothes with tender white arms and legs, blaming Song Zi Xing for hidden injuries that let Star Lord Wan Xiang perish in the eighth star hall.

Fang Yuan asks whether the land spirit remembers him as a past buyer of star fragment grass and the killer move spring star rain from the main body. Star Form Child’s gaze flickers, his expression softens, and he says he has some impression.

He looks as if carved from jade. He wears pinkish blue clothes wrapped around his chest and stomach. His small arms and legs are tender white like lotus roots. He hovers in the air with small cheeks puffing in anger.

He has assimilated with the blessed land and stands as the representative of that land’s will. He nods that he needs help to protect the foundation, then sets conditions. If someone wants to become the blessed land’s owner, that person must bring him Song Zi Xing’s head, because Song Zi Xing forced the main body to expose its secret and explore the grotto-heaven with Immortal Monkey King Shi Lei. He urges haste because an earthly calamity is coming soon, refuses to let any external Gu Immortal stay more than seven minutes, and says only his master can help him pass tribulation. He plans to spread the ownership request through treasure yellow heaven without exposing the blessed land’s location, then sends Fang Yuan and Hei Lou Lan out.

In Earth Abyss Fang Yuan calls for Star Form land spirit and presents Song Zi Xing’s head. After the spirit verifies the head, the starlight door opens fully and Star Form land spirit greets him as master with cheerful submission. The land spirit still looks like a little boy in pinkish blue clothes with tender white arms and legs, floating in the air, and after the acknowledgment he looks at Fang Yuan with admiration and warmth while guiding an inspection of the blessed land.
